During the grace period, search remains available but new ingestion is paused after the first day. Update the card in Settings > Billing. Successful payment resumes ingestion without requiring a new workspace.

answer: The document ingestion endpoint accepts PDF, DOCX, TXT and Markdown files. Each uploaded file must be no larger than 25 MB. A batch can contain at most 20 files. Image-only PDFs need the OCR add-on; uploading a larger file returns HTTP 413. Split large documents before uploading them.
